Q: Unique combinations of length 2^N of four elements with constraints A:

Using itertools.product:

from itertools import product

n = 3

for c in product('AB', 'XY', repeat=2**(n-1)):
    print(*c)

A X A X A X B X
...

B Y B Y B Y B Y

Q: Calling `insert( InputIt first, InputIt last )` for assotiative containers with `first` and `last` being into `*this` A:

It is undefined behaviour. Standard requires iterators passed to insert to not be from the container that is inserted into.

From current draft [unord.req.general]#106-109 (emphasis mine):

a.insert(i, j)
Result: void
Preconditions: value_type is Cpp17EmplaceConstructible into X from *i. Neither i nor j are iterators into a.
Effects: Equivalent to a.insert(t) for each element in [i, j).
Complexity: Average case O(N), where N is distance (i, j), worst case O(N(a.size()+1)).

Where

  • X denotes an unordered associative container class
  • a denotes a value of type X,
  • [i, j) denotes a valid range,
